# Finite-Design Owner Questions

## `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-102D-01`

Does the owner approve the following complete finite-design candidate as one
indivisible base-v0.1 disposition?

| Mechanic | Exact candidate; recommendation, not current owner approval |
| --- | --- |
| Population | Canonically ordered active positive-mass detector identities, partitioned by exact network; ambiguous membership is unavailable. |
| Zero mass | Retain in complete population and provenance, but exclude from active balance and give an inert non-randomized assignment state. |
| Zero-total stratum | Mark inactive and do not evaluate a ratio; preserve the state explicitly. |
| Singleton active stratum | Permit only if its exact rational tolerance makes a sign admissible; otherwise design resolution fails. |
| Tolerance | One preregistered exact rational `tau_h` per stratum, with `0 <= tau_h < 1`; exact integer/rational comparison, never floating approximate equality. |
| Admissibility | Every active stratum satisfies the exact `SCI-NOI-EQ-004` bound. |
| Base candidate law | Independent symmetric Bernoulli signs over the exact ordered active detector domain. |
| Search | First admissible candidate in a deterministic bounded sequence; positive preregistered retry cap. |
| Conditional law | Conditional on successful bounded resolution, uniform over admissible sign vectors under the symmetric base law; retry cap changes resolution probability, not that conditional law. |
| Replacement | Draw candidates and resolved members with replacement. |
| Complements | Complement-related assignments are distinct; no complement pair is forced. |
| Duplicates | Retain exact duplicates as draws; report byte-identical uniqueness separately. |
| Weights | Equal admitted-member weights after successful atomic completion. |
| Count domain | Positive preregistered integer requested count; resolved count must equal requested count before execution begins. |
| Rank | Report exact uncentered sign-design rank and named projected map rank separately from all counts and effective Monte Carlo information. |
| Generator/keying | Plan-bound deterministic generator identity/version, canonical encoding/order, exact seed/key bytes, namespace, and member/candidate indices. |
| Failure | Retry exhaustion fails design resolution; no partial design, tolerance relaxation, reseeding, or fallback. |

Until the answer is yes, every row remains proposed and detailed design routes
are unavailable. A partial yes requires a new complete question rather than a
mixed default.

## `SCI-NOI-OWNER-Q-SCOPE-01`

Does the owner approve one base-v0.1 ensemble per exact observation and array,
with no cross-observation ensemble and no randomized coadd, leaving every
multi-observation/coadd route to a separately versioned contract?

Until yes, base product scope is unavailable.
